title: 768. Max Chunks To Make Sorted II

examples.explanation: Splitting into two or more chunks will not return the required result. For example, splitting into [5, 4], [3, 2, 1] will result in [4, 5, 1, 2, 3], which isn't sorted.
We can split into two chunks, such as [2, 1], [3, 4, 4]. However, splitting into [2, 1], [3], [4], [4] is the highest number of chunks possible.
